import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static int n, t;
    static final int SZ = 15;
    char[][] field = new char[SZ][SZ];
    char[][] capsule = new char[SZ][SZ];
    int[][] Z = new int[SZ][SZ];
    int[][] S = new int[SZ][SZ];
    int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    boolean in(int i, int j) {
        return i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n;
    }

    boolean isDigit(char ch) {
        return ch >= '0' && ch <= '9';
    }

    class Dinic {
        int[] head, cur, d;
        int[] v, nxt, cap;
        int tot, src, sink;
        int MAXN = 210;
        int MAXE = 200000;

        Dinic() {
            head = new int[MAXN];
            cur = new int[MAXN];
            d = new int[MAXN];
            v = new int[MAXE];
            nxt = new int[MAXE];
            cap = new int[MAXE];
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            tot = 0;
        }

        void add(int u, int v, int cap) {
            this.v[tot] = v;
            nxt[tot] = head[u];
            cap[tot] = cap;
            head[u] = tot++;
            this.v[tot] = u;
            nxt[tot] = head[v];
            cap[tot] = 0;
            head[v] = tot++;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            System.arraycopy(head, 0, cur, 0, MAXN);
            d[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.add(src);
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = Q.poll();
                for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                    int v = this.v[i];
                    if (d[v] == -1 && cap[i] > 0) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                        Q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[sink] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int in) {
            if (u == sink) return in;
            int flow = 0, f;
            for (int i = cur[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                cur[u] = i;
                int v = this.v[i];
                if (d[v] == d[u] + 1 && cap[i] > 0) {
                    f = dfs(v, Math.min(in - flow, cap[i]));
                    if (f > 0) {
                        flow += f;
                        cap[i] -= f;
                        cap[i ^ 1] += f;
                        if (flow == in) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow < in) d[u] = -1;
            return flow;
        }

        int dinic(int _src, int _sink) {
            src = _src;
            sink = _sink;
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                flow += dfs(src, INF);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    void bfs(int x, int y, int[][] d, boolean f) {
        int sx = x, sy = y;
        for (int i = 0; i < SZ; i++) Arrays.fill(d[i], INF);
        d[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.add(new int[]{x, y});
        if (f && isDigit(capsule[x][y])) {
            F.add(sx * n + sy, sx * n + sy + n * n, INF);
        }
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = Q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            if (d[x][y] == t) continue;
            for (int o = 0; o < 4; o++) {
                int xx = x + dx[o];
                int yy = y + dy[o];
                if (in(xx, yy) && d[xx][yy] == INF && capsule[xx][yy] != 'Y') {
                    if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x][y] + 1 || (Z[xx][yy] == d[x][y] + 1 && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy]))) {
                        d[xx][yy] = d[x][y] + 1;
                        if (f && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                            F.add(sx * n + sy, xx * n + yy + n * n, INF);
                        }
                        if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x][y] + 1 || !f) {
                            Q.add(new int[]{xx, yy});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Dinic F;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        int src = n * n * 2, sink = src + 1;
        F = new Dinic();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (field[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    x = i; y = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            capsule[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isDigit(capsule[i][j])) {
                    F.add(i * n + j + n * n, sink, capsule[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        bfs(x, y, Z, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isDigit(field[i][j])) {
                    F.add(src, i * n + j, field[i][j] - '0');
                    bfs(i, j, S, true);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(F.dinic(src, sink));
    }
}
